paragraphs.text: Do you ever feel stuck, repeating the same patterns of behaviour again and again? Do you wonder where you are going wrong, making choices that don't reflect the life you want to live? Do you feel there's no one to share these thoughts with, afraid of burdening the ones you love?
You are not alone with these feelings. In today's fast moving world, we don't make the time to slow down and really look at our lives — to understand how we can change and move forward.
That's what I offer you — a space to reflect, to understand yourself better, and to build the life you deserve.

about.headline: Trained in the *person-centred* tradition.
about.bio: I'm a qualified counsellor based in Glasgow, with five years' experience in private practice. My training is in the person-centred approach — sitting with people with warmth, without judgement, and with a belief that you already hold the answers you're looking for.
about.quote: The curious paradox is that when I accept myself just as I am, then I can change.

address.streetAddress: The Consulting Rooms, 34 West George Street

hero.lead: Counselling for adults navigating life's difficult moments — anxiety, low mood, grief, relationships, and the patterns we can't quite see on our own.

items.quote: Daryl is thoughtful and patient, and has a calm and contemplative approach that allows you to walk through the issues that are affecting you, and give helpful advice on next steps.
I felt that Daryl really listened. He was very astute and picked up on a lot of things I wasn't aware I was thinking or feeling. I found the sessions very beneficial.
Daryl understands my needs and is a great contributor.

items.title: Initial consultation
items.body: A free phone or online consultation to understand what you're looking for and whether we're a good fit. No obligation.

items.title: 50-minute sessions

items.title: Ongoing support
items.body: We'll review regularly to check the work is serving you. Short-term focused work or longer-term exploration — both are welcome.
